glosses: To return something to its original place.

examples.text: He carefully put the vase back on the shelf.

examples.text: You'll need to put that drink back quickly; it's very nearly closing time.

glosses: To change the time in a time zone to an earlier time.

examples.text: Don't forget that this Sunday we put the clocks back an hour.

examples.text: When you've finished using the telephone, please replace the handset.
